note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. ONS Local Planning Authorities (May 2025) Names and Codes provides authoritative LPA25CD and LPA25NM identifiers for UK LPAs. This supplies an exact official identifier vocabulary that could bind a known LPA code/name to coverage geometry.
